requested_outcome: Audit and safely repair the complete VII public routing, multilingual crawl surfaces, legacy redirects, breadcrumbs, and administration experience, then produce a frozen release candidate with evidence without publishing it.
natural_destination: The VII public site and protected administration system represented by the exact frozen candidate, with production left unchanged until explicit publication approval.
authorization_boundary: Read-only production checks and local code changes, builds and tests are authorized. Production publication, DNS, indexing changes, cloud infrastructure and external messaging are not authorized in this request.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request asks whether everything is done and requires a complete family-wide proof, not a point fix.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every route family and changed capability must map to evidence, a precise blocker or a justified exclusion, with exact candidate identity.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user explicitly requires the administration system to operate and look like the platform.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Administration capability, persistence, authorization, reflection and visual-state evidence are separate gates.

lesson_bundle.reason: Sitemaps, crawl files, languages, redirects and indexability are the core request.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Canonical, hreflang, robots, sitemap, schema, status and measurement families must be audited from real responses.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request includes all tools and multilingual site-management coverage.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: CMS modules for content, SEO, navigation, media, URLs and redirects require explicit inventory and evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user expects a premium futuristic platform-level administration appearance.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Admin desktop and mobile visual hierarchy, spacing, empty states and full-page composition must be inspected.

lesson_bundle.reason: Navigation and breadcrumbs must be consistent across all worlds and languages.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Vacation is the structural reference and every parallel world and locale must be compared against it.

lesson_bundle.reason: The earlier multilingual defects included mixed-language content and non-native public copy.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every language must be checked for mixed-language leftovers in navigation, metadata, cards and public interface copy.

lesson_bundle.reason: The affected public and admin families have repeatedly failed on mobile.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Representative public and admin routes require 390-pixel and low-height evidence in addition to desktop.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the sitemap index is checked while child maps, localized routes or excluded pages are missed.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inventory every sitemap and compare canonical URLs, locale alternates, route existence and indexability.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A machine-readable sitemap matrix records every discovered sitemap, URL count, language, status and defect.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Breadcrumb labels are repaired but URL, canonical, schema or redirect state still disagrees.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Treat URL, canonical, breadcrumb UI, BreadcrumbList and legacy redirect as one contract.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Cross-world samples in all four languages have matching route, canonical, schema and hierarchy, and changed paths have direct permanent redirects.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Known redirects pass but the full legacy inventory still has missing, chained, looping or homepage fallbacks.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Run the complete stored legacy inventory and migration audits, then classify every unresolved source.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The redirect report has zero loops, chains, non-ASCII destinations and accidental homepage catch-alls, with unresolved sources listed precisely.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The administration system gets cosmetic styling but daily tasks, modules, permissions or persistence remain incomplete.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inventory the complete admin route and capability family before changing shared presentation.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Admin evidence covers sign-in, authorization, navigation, loading, empty, error, save/reload and natural-surface reflection for supported modules.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The candidate passes source tests but is not visually inspected on desktop and mobile.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Create deterministic local candidate captures and inspect full pages for public and admin representative routes.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Opened desktop, 390-pixel and low-height captures exist for every changed template family and no unexplained visual defects remain.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The work is reported as live even though no publication was authorized.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep production unchanged and label the result as a candidate until a separate explicit publish instruction.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Final evidence names the commit/build identity, states production unchanged and records publication as not authorized.

affected_family: public route templates for vacations, events, rooms VIP, spa, discovery, suppliers, guides, gift cards, search and managed pages
Hebrew, English, French and Russian localized routes
visual breadcrumbs and BreadcrumbList structured data
canonical, hreflang, robots, sitemap and metadata output
legacy redirect inventory and changed canonical paths
desktop header, mobile menu, footer and internal links
administration shell and content, growth, navigation, redirect, sitemap, analytics and operational modules

sources.label: Vacation breadcrumb reference
sources.source: Approved order: home, world, region, city, place

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the first complete route, sitemap, redirect and admin inventory is generated, before modifying shared routing or visual-system code.
checks: Confirm whether breadcrumb changes actually changed URLs.
Confirm the exact missing multilingual and redirect families.
Inspect one admin desktop and mobile route before expanding any visual change.

attack_questions: Can any sitemap URL return non-200, wrong canonical, wrong language or unexpected noindex?
Can any legacy source redirect through a chain, loop, homepage fallback or non-equivalent destination?
Can any world or language show a breadcrumb hierarchy that disagrees with URL or structured data?
Can any promised admin module look polished but fail authorization, persistence or reflection?
Does any representative desktop, mobile or low-height route remain visually broken or mixed-language?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact candidate routes opened and inspected in a real browser, plus read-only production comparison where safe.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Complete route, language, sitemap, redirect, navigation and admin matrices with test output and screenshots.

effectiveness.baseline: Earlier QA found multilingual metadata and map defects, and the complete current sitemap, redirect and admin visual families have not yet been re-certified together.
effectiveness.target: Prevent incomplete done claims by producing one reproducible candidate and a precise remaining-blocker list before any publication request.
